name: HB Australasia
summary: Hobart ISP trading as 'Southern Internet Services' (H.B. Australasia Pty Ltd, ACN 066 489 852, from 2000); distinct from southcom.com.au's Southern Internet Services.

events.details: Hobart ISP (Southern Internet Services trading name).

Defunct. The southcom.com.au retail ISP identity (Southern Internet Services / Labyrinth Connections) was retired into KeyPoint with a hard launch date of 18 Nov 2002, beating both the current c. 2005 and the proposal's c. 2003. merged/rebranded into KeyPoint.

refs.label: Nov 2002 homepage announces the merger and the exact KeyPoint launch date, 18 Nov 2002.
By 2 Feb 2003 the southcom.com.au homepage was a KeyPoint redirect notice; raw HTTP 302 redirects to KeyPoint follow from Sep 2003 (CDX).
